title: Public School Locations (NCES EDGE 2024-25)
agency: National Center for Education Statistics, U.S. Department of Education
publisher: National Center for Education Statistics (NCES), U.S. Department of Education
source_relationship: Official NCES EDGE annual public-school location distribution, based on the 2024-25 Common Core of Data. The HIFLD/DataLumos archive describes its public-school inventory as 2022-23 CCD data. A common producer does not establish row-level historical equivalence.

source_observation.hifld_archive_vintage: 2022-23 CCD according to DataLumos metadata; historical row-level crosswalk not established

observed_layer.text_member_crosschecked: All 102,178 rows and 23 values per row match the shapefile attributes; coordinate text values differ only within 1e-12 decimal rounding tolerance.

license_claim: The NCES layer description states that all information in the 2024-25 public-school locations layer is in the public domain. HIFLD reuse and downstream rights/attribution decisions remain pending.
